_comment: Each variant is a flat list of fragment paths (relative to ./fragments/). The build script concatenates them verbatim in order. Fragments in shared/ are reused across variants; variant-specific fragments live under fragments/<variant>/. To add a new variant, copy an existing entry and swap in the variant-specific fragments.

sis.description: Set-In Sleeve sweater — V-neck, front/back/sleeves construction (baseline).

sacasis.description: Sand-Cable Set-In Sleeve sweater — SIS with a central sand-cable panel on the front. Reuses every shared fragment; swaps in cable-aware abbreviations and front-piece copy.
